name: conveyor-belt
description: Issue-to-merged-commit automation for Claude Code: one issue becomes one card, built in a fresh worktree, reviewed, tested, landed, and pushed when you choose.

boardAutoOpen.title: Open the Board at start
boardAutoOpen.description: Open the Conveyor Board in the browser when a session starts in a repo with a Conveyor pack.

band.title: Band
band.description: The /units rows above the prompt. auto: on in main, where the Foreman runs, off in worker panes.

pane.title: Side pane
pane.description: The Conveyor pane: every section of /units, one line an item. auto: on in main, where the Foreman runs, off in worker panes.

status.title: Status line and toasts
status.description: The pinned status line and the toasts for a card that newly needs you or lands. auto: on in main, where the Foreman runs, off in worker panes.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Turns the mark of each card on the belt once a second. off: the mark stands still.
